meta.name: decisive-battle-motivation-strategy
meta.description: Use when commanding troops in a decisive battle requiring total commitment. Applies the 破釜沉舟 (break cauldrons, sink boats) technique to eliminate retreat, limit provisions to 3 days, and force maximum engagement. Based on Xiang Yu at Julu (钜鹿之战).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用破釜沉舟策略指挥决战部队
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要模拟古代决战中的决绝战术。
copy.tagline_en: Command troops with a burn-the-boats strategy for decisive battles.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to simulate ancient decisive battle tactics with total commitment.

howto.what: 当你需要策划一场破釜沉舟的决战时，Claude 会帮你制定销毁所有撤退工具、只留三天口粮、激励部队全力战斗的策略，强制部队背水一战。
howto.when: 当你在军事或策略场景中要求制定背水一战的决战策略时触发。

say.text: 帮我策划一场破釜沉舟的决战，销毁所有船只和炊具。
say.note: Claude 会生成具体的行动步骤。

say.text: 我需要背水一战的策略，只留三天口粮，切断退路。
say.note: Claude 会提供激励士气和部署方案。

howto.what_en: Claude will apply the 'break cauldrons, sink boats' technique to devise a decisive battle plan: destroy all retreat means, limit provisions to 3 days, and force full commitment for a do-or-die engagement.
howto.when_en: When you need to command troops in a decisive battle requiring total commitment and no retreat.

say_en.text: Plan a decisive battle with no retreat—sink boats and break pots.
say_en.note: Claude outlines steps to destroy retreat options.

say_en.text: Give me a do-or-die strategy with only 3 days of rations.
say_en.note: Claude produces a full commitment plan.
